name: Luna Toons
_note: Custom PHP site (htmx partials). Listings/paging/search/chapter-list are JSON endpoints returning HTML fragments; series metadata comes from the JSON-LD @type:"Book" node. Pages are plain AVIF on cdn.meowing.org — no descramble, no referer required. Paid chapters carry a 🔒 prefix + #lock suffix and are refused at pages() time — never purchased/unlocked.
